purpose: Adjust one or multiple numeric values on a bounded track with named thumbs.
behaviorProvider: Base UI Slider with Aegis orientation/inversion mapping.

component: Use value/defaultValue arrays; the uncontrolled default is [min]. Delegate min/max/step/minStepsBetweenThumbs and interaction to Base UI, with thumbCollisionBehavior none and edge alignment.
Report logical arrays from onValueChange and onValueCommit. The wrapper does not expose primitive callback details or cancellation; a commit is interaction completion rather than persistence.

Horizontal inversion reverses the direction context. Vertical inversion mirrors and reverses visual values, maps callbacks back to logical values, and handles Home/End against logical bounds and adjacent-thumb spacing.

Give the first real range input the Field id and each extra thumb a distinct id/name description. For ordinary orientation use primitive form inputs; vertical inversion emits hidden logical values under name instead of visual values.

Associate Field help/error with the thumbs, apply formatValue to aria-valuetext and provide default Value/Minimum/Maximum/Threshold names or host thumbLabels. The visual value output is aria-hidden to avoid duplicate announcements.
host: Supply finite ordered bounds with min<max, a positive step and appropriately ordered value arrays. Own value acceptance, precision, validation and submit/persistence policy; provide meaningful thumb labels and formatting for the domain.

Owned styling belongs to the input token group. Actual nested shared components retain their own group and behavior; preserve four theme/mode mappings and keyboard-visible focus.

limitations: Source-backed requirements, not a current test certification or release approval.
No readOnly API or native required enforcement is added by this wrapper.
Arbitrary precision, non-linear scales and automatic domain validation are not supplied. Empty/invalid arrays and degenerate bounds are host configuration errors, not normalized here.
